name: Neri Tern
seed: Teacher and makers-club organizer. Wants good questions but overplans. Home: East Orchard.
design: Red panda with cream cheek patches, moss jacket, plum scarf, folding paper models.
history: Left Willowmere after teaching mixed-age growing classes and came to East Orchard three years ago.
desire: To make curiosity a public habit rather than a school-only activity.
contradiction: Plans every discovery so carefully that learners cannot surprise her.
relationships: Sori shares her home region; Jun challenges inaccessible signs; Senn sends seed stories.
arc: Lets an unfinished question remain open, follows a student’s route, and changes the next lesson because of what happened.
story_engine: Children design a misleading map; a visiting elder tells a history that contradicts her lesson plan.
writer_truth: She failed an entrance exam for a prestigious teaching hall and still hides the rejection letter.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
